statusDetail: The entry page could not be audited because the origin edge returned HTTP 403 Access Denied to both raw-CDP Chrome and curl. No intended site content, representative route, or primary flow was reachable.

page.notes: Only an Akamai/EdgeSuite Access Denied document was observable; the intended application profile could not be determined.

Independent HTTP response body containing Access Denied.
